mapper.select: SELECT d.TRD_DSP_SN AS disputeSn, d.TRD_SN AS tradeSn, d.DSPT_USR_SN AS disputerUserSn, d.TRD_DSP_STATUS_CD AS disputeStatusCode, d.TRD_DSP_RSLT_CD AS disputeResultCode, d.TRD_DSP_PREV_TRD_STATUS_CD AS previousTradeStatusCode, t.TRD_TYPE_CD AS tradeTypeCode, t.TRD_STATUS_CD AS tradeStatusCode, t.BID_SN AS bidSn, t.SLLR_USR_SN AS sellerUserSn, t.BYPR_USR_SN AS buyerUserSn, t.REQ_USR_SN AS requesterUserSn, t.PRV_USR_SN AS providerUserSn FROM TRADE_DISPUTE d JOIN TRADE t ON t.TRD_SN = d.TRD_SN WHERE d.TRD_DSP_SN = #{disputeSn} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE TRADE SET TRD_STATUS_CD = #{targetStatusCode}, TRD_AUTO_CMPL_DT = CASE WHEN #{targetStatusCode} = 'TRDC0005' THEN TRD_AUTO_CMPL_DT ELSE NULL END, TRD_UPDT_ID = #{updaterId}, TRD_UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE TRD_SN = #{tradeSn} AND TRD_STATUS_CD = #{expectedStatusCode}

UPDATE TRADE_DISPUTE SET TRD_DSP_RSLT_CD = #{resultCode}, TRD_DSP_STATUS_CD = #{statusCode}, TRD_DSP_PROC_RSN_CN = #{reason}, TRD_DSP_PROC_USR_SN = #{processorUserSn}, TRD_DSP_PROC_DT = NOW(), TRD_DSP_UPDT_ID = #{updaterId}, TRD_DSP_UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE TRD_DSP_SN = #{disputeSn} AND TRD_DSP_STATUS_CD IN ('TRDC0016', 'TRDC0017')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TRADE_STATUS_HIST ( TRD_SN, TRD_STS_HST_STATUS_CD, TRD_STS_HST_RSN_CN, TRD_STS_HST_REG_ID, TRD_STS_HST_UPDT_ID ) VALUES ( #{tradeSn}, #{statusCode}, #{reason}, #{updaterId}, #{updaterId} )
